cases.title: Standard repo scan finding all three duplication types
cases.user_request: Run a duplication hunt on this repository. Find exact copies, renamed duplicates, and structural duplicates. Show me the top 15 findings ranked by extraction value.

notes: Repository contains both production and test code.
There are known exact duplicates in the authentication modules.
Some utility functions follow the same pattern with different types (structural duplication).
Test setup code is repeated across multiple test files.

artifact_requirements: Markdown report with findings ranked by extraction value score
Each finding includes type, occurrence count, block size, locations with file:line, and code preview
Extraction suggestions with function name, parameters, and target location
Summary with type breakdown, total duplicated lines, and top extraction candidates
static_checks: Findings include at least one of each duplication type (exact, renamed, structural)
Every file path and line range in findings exists in the repository
Each finding has a score computed from occurrences, block size, and type weight
Findings are sorted by score descending
review_questions: Are the exact duplicates genuinely identical across their reported locations?
Do the extraction suggestions include concrete function names and parameter lists rather than vague advice?

cases.title: Custom minimum block size and occurrence count
cases.user_request: Run a duplication hunt with a minimum block size of 8 lines and require at least 3 occurrences for all duplication types. I only want to see patterns that appear frequently.

notes: User wants a higher bar: 8-line minimum and 3+ occurrences.
This should filter out small or low-frequency duplicates that appear with default settings.
Findings should be fewer but higher-value.

artifact_requirements: Markdown report using 8-line minimum and 3-occurrence minimum
No findings with block size under 8 lines
No findings with fewer than 3 occurrences
static_checks: Report states the configured thresholds (8 lines, 3 occurrences)
No finding has a block size under 8 lines
No finding has fewer than 3 occurrences
review_questions: Did the agent correctly apply both the block size and occurrence count thresholds?
Are any findings that would appear with default settings correctly filtered out?

cases.title: Intentional boilerplate is not flagged
cases.user_request: Run a duplication hunt on this repository. Make sure it does not flag license headers, standard import blocks, or trivial getter/setter methods as duplication findings.

notes: Every source file starts with a 4-line license header.
Many files share similar 2-3 line import blocks.
Data model classes have trivial getter/setter methods that look identical structurally.
None of these should be flagged — they are intentional repetition.

artifact_requirements: Markdown report that excludes license headers, short import blocks, and trivial getters/setters
If any boilerplate-like patterns are noted, they are acknowledged as excluded rather than findings
Findings focus on non-trivial duplicated logic
static_checks: No finding is a license header block
No finding is an import block of 3 lines or fewer
No finding is a trivial getter or setter method
review_questions: Does the report correctly exclude intentional boilerplate patterns?
If any borderline cases exist (e.g., a 5-line import block), are they handled reasonably?
